heroData.title: EOR & PEO in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: Hire in Vietnam without a local entity
heroData.description: Fast-track your expansion into Vietnam using an Employer of Record. Compliantly hire local talent in days.
heroData.bestFor: Startups and companies testing the market

steps.title: Document Collection
steps.text: Gather essential documents from the employee, including National ID (CCCD), tax identification number (MST), and bank account details.

steps.title: Contract Drafting
steps.text: Draft a compliant labor contract in Vietnamese (bilingual recommended). Must specify salary in VND.

steps.title: Social Insurance Registration
steps.text: Register the employee with the Social Insurance agency. This is mandatory upon signing the labor contract.

steps.title: Onboarding & IT Setup
steps.text: Provision equipment and grant access to company systems. EOR handles the payroll enrollment.

rows.title: Management Fee
rows.description: Monthly flat fee per employee charged by the EOR provider, varying by volume.

rows.title: Employer Taxes
rows.description: Mandatory social, health, and union contributions on top of gross salary.

rows.title: setup Fees
rows.description: One-time onboarding fee per employee, often waived for annual contracts.

rows.title: Deposit
rows.description: Security deposit equivalent to 1 or 2 months of payroll to cover liabilities.

items.title: Permanent Establishment
items.text: Using an EOR reduces PE risk, but having senior managers making contracts in Vietnam can still trigger it.

items.title: Probation Periods
items.text: Strictly regulated: max 60 days for require college degree jobs, 30 days for vocational, 180 days for executives.

items.title: Termination Rights
items.text: Vietnam is pro-employee. Unilateral termination by employer is very difficult and requires strict legal grounds.

items.title: Currency Rule
items.text: All employment contracts and salary payments to residents must be denominated in VND.

items.title: 13th Month Salary
items.text: Not legally mandatory but practically standard. Usually equals one month's salary paid before Tet holiday.

items.title: Public Holidays
items.text: Employees are entitled to 11 fully paid public holidays per year (increasing to 13-14 days depending on lunar calendar impact).

items.title: Import Duties
items.text: Sending laptops from abroad incurs high import taxes (10-30%) and VAT (10%). Customs clearance can be slow.

items.title: Local Procurement
items.text: Highly recommended to buy locally (e.g., FPT Shop, CellphoneS). Warranty support is local and delivery is instant.

items.title: Asset Management
items.text: EOR provider usually doesn't hold assets. Assets must be gifted to employee or owned by foreign entity (complex).

faqs.question: Can EOR employees obtain stock options?
faqs.answer: Yes, but tax handling for ESOPs in Vietnam is complex and EORs often require specific indemnity clauses.

faqs.question: Are background checks legal?
faqs.answer: Yes, but they require explicit candidate consent due to strict Personal Data Protection Decree (PDPD).

faqs.question: How long can I use an EOR?
faqs.answer: Ideally for 12-18 months. Long-term use generally increases PE risk and compliance scrutiny.

faqs.question: Does the EOR handle visa processing?
faqs.answer: Yes, EORs can sponsor work permits and TRCs (Temporary Residence Cards) for foreign employees.

steps.title: Data Collection
steps.text: Cut-off date typically 20th-25th. Gather overtime, leave, and bonus data.

steps.title: Calculation
steps.text: Calculate Gross-to-Net, applying SI/HI/UI deductions and progressive PIT rates.

steps.title: Approval & Payment
steps.text: Approve preliminary payroll. Transfer Net Salary to employees by the last working day.

steps.title: Remittance
steps.text: Remit SHUI contributions and withheld PIT to tax authorities by month-end or 20th of next month.

rows.title: Social Insurance
rows.description: Retirement (14%), Sickness/Maternity (3%), Occupational Disease (0.5%).

rows.title: Health Insurance
rows.description: Mandatory contribution to the national health fund.

rows.title: Unemployment Ins.
rows.description: Applicable for Vietnamese nationals only (0% for expats).

rows.title: Trade Union Fee
rows.description: Capped at 10% of base salary multiplier, mandatory for all companies.

items.title: Paid Leave
items.text: Minimum 12 days annual leave. Increases by 1 day for every 5 years of service.

items.title: Sick Leave
items.text: Paid by Social Insurance Agency, not employer (unless company offers top-up). Rate is 75% of salary.

items.title: Maternity Leave
items.text: 6 months mandatory leave. Paid by Social Insurance Agency at 100% of average salary cap.

items.title: Salary Confidentiality
items.text: Culturally sensitive, but pay slips must be provided. Discussing salary is common among peers.

items.title: Dependent Deductions
items.text: Employees can claim 4.4M VND/month deduction per dependent for PIT calculation. Requires registration.

items.title: Overtime Caps
items.text: Strictly capped at 40h/month and 200h/year. Requires report to Dept of Labor for exceptions.

steps.title: Standard Weekday
steps.text: Overtime on regular working days is paid at 150% of the actual hourly wage.

steps.title: Weekend / Rest Day
steps.text: Work performed on weekly rest days (usually Saturday/Sunday) is paid at 200% of the actual hourly wage.

steps.title: Public Holiday / Tet
steps.text: Work on public holidays and paid leave days is paid at 300% of the actual hourly wage, generally separate from holiday pay.

steps.title: Night Shift Premium
steps.text: Night work (10 PM - 6 AM) incurs an additional 30% premium. Night overtime calculates to roughly 200% (weekday), 270% (weekend), or 390% (holiday).

steps.title: Form 02/ĐK-NPT-TNCN
steps.text: Employee submits registration form to HR/Employer. HR consolidates and submits Form 20-ĐK-TH-TCT to Tax Authority.

steps.title: Document Proof
steps.text: Children <18: Birth certificate. Spouse: Marriage cert + proof of low income. Parents: ID/Household book + proof of low income.

steps.title: Deadline
steps.text: Must be registered to claim the 4.4M VND/month deduction. Late registration may result in lost deductions for past months.

steps.title: Tax Code
steps.text: Dependents must be issued a Dependent Tax Code by the Tax Authority to be valid.

rows.title: Late Declaration
rows.description: Fine for submitting PIT/SHUI declarations past the deadline (tier-based).

rows.title: Late Payment
rows.description: Daily interest on the unpaid tax/insurance amount.

rows.title: Evasion
rows.description: Serious evasion (e.g., hiding income) incurs 100% to 300% of tax evaded.

rows.title: SHUI Evasion
rows.description: Fine of 12% to 15% of total evaded insurance contributions (max 75M VND).

faqs.question: Can I pay in USD?
faqs.answer: No. For Vietnamese residents, salary must be paid in VND. Expats can receive foreign currency but VND is preferred.

faqs.question: Is the 13th month salary taxable?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is treated as regular taxable income for PIT purposes.

faqs.question: When are tax filings due?
faqs.answer: Monthly declarations by the 20th of the following month. Annual finalization by March 31st.

steps.title: Determine Base
steps.text: Start with Gross Salary. Identify portions subject to SI/HI (capped at 20x base salary).

steps.title: Deduct Exemptions
steps.text: Subtract personal deduction (11M VND) and dependent deductions (4.4M/person).

steps.title: Apply PIT Rate
steps.text: Apply progressive tax rate (5% to 35%) on taxable income.

steps.title: Calculate Net
steps.text: Gross - (Employee SI/HI/UI) - PIT = Net Salary.

rows.title: Social Insurance
rows.description: Retirement & Sickness funds. Capped at salary of 46.8M VND (2025 est).

rows.title: Health Insurance
rows.description: Medical coverage. Capped same as SI.

rows.title: Unemployment
rows.description: Capped at 20x regional minimum wage. 0% for Expats.

rows.title: Trade Union
rows.description: Capped at 10% of base salary multiplier. Mandatory.

items.title: SI/HI Cap
items.text: 20x Base Salary. (Approx 46.8M VND). Salary above this is not subject to 17.5% + 3% charge.

items.title: UI Cap
items.text: 20x Regional Minimum Wage. (Region 1: ~99M VND cap).

items.title: Personal Deduction
items.text: 11,000,000 VND / month self-deduction for PIT.

items.title: Overtime Rates
items.text: Weekday: 150%. Weekend: 200%. Holiday: 300%. Night shift: +30%.

items.title: Non-Taxable
items.text: Certain allowances (lunch, phone, uniform) are exempt from PIT if within caps.

items.title: Net vs Gross
items.text: If contract is Net, employer must gross-up taxes. Gross contracts are safer.

faqs.question: Is lunch allowance taxable?
faqs.answer: Exempt up to 730,000 VND/month. Above that is taxable.

faqs.question: Are severance payments taxable?
faqs.answer: Statutory severance is tax-exempt. Voluntary excess severance is taxable.

faqs.question: Do interns pay tax?
faqs.answer: Income above 2M VND/month is subject to 10% withholding tax.

heroData.title: Incorporation in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: Set up your legal entity in Vietnam
heroData.description: Step-by-step guide to company registration, from IRC to ERC.

steps.title: Investment Registration (IRC)
steps.text: Apply for Investment Registration Certificate. Requires proving financial capacity and office lease.

steps.title: Enterprise Registration (ERC)
steps.text: Apply for Enterprise Registration Certificate. This is the official 'birth certificate' of the company.

steps.title: Seal & Tax Registration
steps.text: Carve the company seal, register sample with portal, and complete initial tax registration.

steps.title: Bank Account Opening
steps.text: Open Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) and current account. Inject capital within 90 days.

rows.title: Government Fees
rows.description: Official filing fees for IRC, ERC, and seal registration.

rows.title: Legal/Agency Fees
rows.description: Professional fees for drafting, submission, and follow-up with DPI.

rows.title: Virtual Office
rows.description: Required for registration address. Most providers require 6-12 months upfront.

rows.title: Minimum Capital
rows.description: No legal minimum for most sectors, but this amount is practical for approval.

items.title: LLC (1 Member)
items.text: Most common for foreign investors. Liability limited to capital contribution. Simple structure.

items.title: LLC (2+ Members)
items.text: Requires a Members' Council. Good for Joint Ventures. Max 50 members.

items.title: JSC (Joint Stock)
items.text: Required for IPOs. Minimum 3 shareholders. specific governance complexity.

items.title: RO (Rep Office)
items.text: Cannot generate revenue. Can only do market research and liaison. Easiest to setup.

items.title: Capital Injection
items.text: Strict deadline: 90 days from ERC issuance. Failure incurs heavy fines.

items.title: Business License
items.text: Required for retail/trading activities additionally to IRC/ERC. Adds 1-2 months to timeline.

items.title: Electronic Signature
items.text: Immediate purchase of e-signature token is needed for tax filing.

rows.title: Registration Fee
rows.description: Online registration is often free. Paper submission incurs small fees.

rows.title: Publication Fee
rows.description: Mandatory fee to publish registration on National Business Registration Portal.

rows.title: License Tax
rows.description: Annual business license tax (Monbai). 3M for capital >10B VND. 2M below.

rows.title: Seal Carving
rows.description: Cost to create the corporate seal. Digital signatures cost separately.

steps.title: Open Bank Account
steps.text: Open Capital Account (DICA) and Current Account. Notify DPI of bank details.

steps.title: Digital Signature
steps.text: Purchase USB Token (e-signature) from providers like Viettel, VNPT, BKAV.

steps.title: E-Invoice Reg
steps.text: Register for e-invoicing service and notify Tax Authority of invoice template.

steps.title: Signboard
steps.text: Hang company signboard at registered address. Tax officers will verify this physically.

faqs.question: Can a foreigner own 100%?
faqs.answer: Yes, for most sectors (IT, Manufacturing, Consulting). Logistics/Tourism have restrictions.

faqs.question: How long does it take?
faqs.answer: Typically 30-45 working days for standard services. Manufacturing/Trading takes longer.

faqs.question: Do I need a resident director?
faqs.answer: Yes, at least one Legal Representative must reside in Vietnam.

heroData.title: Staffing in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: Recruit top Vietnamese talent
heroData.description: Navigate the recruitment landscape: fees, agencies, and hiring norms.

steps.title: Define Role & Budget
steps.text: Benchmark local salaries. Tech talent in HCMC/Hanoi is competitive.

steps.title: Sourcing
steps.text: Use VietnamWorks, TopDev (for tech), and LinkedIn. Agencies are faster for niche roles.

steps.title: Screening & Interview
steps.text: Assess English proficiency (varies widely). Test technical skills early.

steps.title: Offer & Negotiation
steps.text: Quote salary in Gross. Clarify 'Net' expectations (common in Vietnam).

rows.title: Agency Fee
rows.description: Of candidate's annual gross salary. Retainer may be required for exec search.

rows.title: Posting Fee
rows.description: Per job post on premium boards like VietnamWorks or ITVieck.

rows.title: Background Check
rows.description: Basic check (education, employment history) via third-party vendors.

items.title: Tech Talent Hub
items.text: Vietnam is a top outsourcing destination. Strong backend/frontend skills; soft skills improving.

items.title: Job Hopping
items.text: High turnover (15-20%) in tech. Annual salary reviews and clear growth paths are crucial.

items.title: Tet Bonus
items.text: Candidates expect 13th-month salary. Factor this 8.33% cost into your annual budget.

items.title: Probation
items.text: 2 months is standard for professionals. Salary must be at least 85% of official wage.

items.title: Non-Compete
items.text: Hard to enforce legally in Vietnam unless specifically structured and reasonable.

items.title: Fixed-Term
items.text: Can sign max 2 fixed-term contracts (12-36mo); 3rd must be indefinite.

faqs.question: Can I hire contractors?
faqs.answer: Yes, but beware of misclassification. Long-term exclusive contractors are deemed employees.

faqs.question: What is the average tech salary?
faqs.answer: Junior: $600-$1k. Senior: $2k-$4k. Lead: $4k+. (Monthly Gross)

faqs.question: Is English widely spoken?
faqs.answer: Good in urban centers (HCMC, Hanoi) and among young professionals, but variable elsewhere.

heroData.title: HRIS in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: Digitize your Vietnam HR ops
heroData.description: Top HRIS platforms, compliance features, and implementation guides.

steps.title: Requirements Mapping
steps.text: Identify local needs: PIT calculation, Shifts (for manufacturing), Social Insurance interface.

steps.title: Vendor Selection
steps.text: Choose between local (Base.vn, Tanca) for compliance vs Global (Workday) for HQ reporting.

steps.title: Data Migration
steps.text: Import employee records. Ensure fields match Vietnam labor code (Ethnicity, Hometown).

steps.title: Go-Live & Training
steps.text: Train HR admins and roll out mobile app to staff for leave requests/payslips.

items.title: Base.vn
items.text: Market leader for SMEs. Comprehensive suite (HR, Work, Wework). Strong local UX.

items.title: Tanca
items.text: Strong on scheduling and shift management. Good for retail/F&B.

items.title: Grove HR
items.text: Modern, mobile-first, agile. popular with tech startups.

items.title: SAP/Workday
items.text: Used by enterprises. Often requires 'localization pack' integration for tax.

items.title: Automated PIT
items.text: Must handle progressive tax brackets and auto-deduct for dependents.

items.title: Insurance Reports
items.text: Ability to export standard forms (files) for submission to Social Insurance Agency.

items.title: Data Localization
items.text: Cybersecurity Law implies personal data of Vietnamese users should be stored locally.

rows.title: SME SaaS
rows.description: Per user/month. Affordable tiers from local providers.

rows.title: Implementation
rows.description: One-time setup fee for data migration and training.

rows.title: Enterprise
rows.description: Annual licenses for complex ERP-integrated HR suites.

faqs.question: Can I use Excel?
faqs.answer: For <10 people, yes. But PIT/Insurance compliance quickly becomes unmanageable.

faqs.question: Does it integrate with banks?
faqs.answer: Many local HRIS (like Base) integrate with local banks for automated payroll disbursement.

faqs.question: Language support?
faqs.answer: Critical. System must be bilingual (VN/EN) for mixed teams.

heroData.title: Accounting in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: VAS, IFRS, and Bookkeeping
heroData.description: Master financial compliance: standards, audits, and e-invoicing.

steps.title: Appointment
steps.text: Appoint an independent auditor before fiscal year-end (usually Dec 31). Notify tax authority.

steps.title: Fieldwork
steps.text: Auditors review records, invoices, and bank statements onsite or remotely (Jan-Feb).

steps.title: Draft Report
steps.text: Review draft audited financials. Discuss adjustments with auditor.

steps.title: Submission
steps.text: Sign and submit final report to Licensing Authority, Tax Dept, and Statistics Office by Mar 31.

rows.title: Outsourced Bookkeeping
rows.description: Monthly fee for SMEs depending on transaction volume.

rows.title: Statutory Audit
rows.description: Annual fee per entity. Mandatory for all foreign-owned companies.

rows.title: Chief Accountant returns
rows.description: Fee for signing off on reports if using a junior in-house accountant.

items.title: VAS vs IFRS
items.text: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) are mandatory. Differences exist in revenue recognition and asset valuation.

items.title: FY Definition
items.text: Standard is Jan 1 - Dec 31. Changes require approval from Finance Ministry.

items.title: Language & Currency
items.text: Books must be in Vietnamese and VND. Dual language/currency allowed with approval.

items.title: Mandatory
items.text: 100% compulsory. Paper invoices are obsolete. Must use certified e-invoice providers.

items.title: Instant Validation
items.text: Invoices are sent to Tax Authority for validation codes before issuance to buyers.

items.title: Input VAT
items.text: Strict scrutiny. Input invoices must be legitimate to claim VAT credits.

faqs.question: Can I do accounting in-house?
faqs.answer: Yes, but you must have a licensed Chief Accountant appointed legally.

faqs.question: What is the penalty for late audit?
faqs.answer: Fines ranging from 5M to 30M VND, plus risk of tax inspection.

faqs.question: Are software costs deductible?
faqs.answer: Yes, if compliant invoices are obtained.

steps.title: Jan 30
steps.text: Pay Annual Business License Fee (License Tax).

steps.title: Mar 31
steps.text: Deadline: CIT Finalization, PIT Finalization, Audited Financial Reports, Statistics Report.

steps.title: Monthly (20th)
steps.text: VAT & PIT declarations for the previous month.

steps.title: Quarterly (30th)
steps.text: CIT provisional payment. Report on use of invoices.

rows.title: Late Filing (Tax)
rows.description: Administrative fine depending on delay duration.

rows.title: Late Payment Interest
rows.description: Daily interest charged on the overdue tax amount.

rows.title: Evasion
rows.description: Fine of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount for serious violations.

items.title: DPI
items.text: Dept of Planning & Investment. Grants IRC/ERC. Manages foreign investment.

items.title: GDT
items.text: General Dept of Taxation. Collects taxes, conducts inspections.

items.title: DOLISA
items.text: Dept of Labor, Invalids & Social Affairs. Manages work permits, labor codes.

items.title: SBV
items.text: State Bank of Vietnam. Regulates foreign exchange and banking transactions.

items.title: Capital Account (DICA)
items.text: Failure to route investment funds through DICA freezes ability to repatriate profits.

items.title: Work Permit Gaps
items.text: Expats working while waiting for permit renewal is illegal and risks deportation.

items.title: Address Mis-match
items.text: Registered address must match actual office. Tax officers do site visits.

rows.title: No Work Permit
rows.description: Foreigners working without permit face deportation. Employer fined up to 75M VND.

rows.title: Late Social Insurance
rows.description: Interest + fines on late SI payments. Criminal charges for evasion possible.

rows.title: Unlicensed Website
rows.description: E-commerce sites not notified to MoIT.

rows.title: Advertising
rows.description: Advertising without proper content approval (for special sectors).

faqs.question: How often are tax audits?
faqs.answer: Typically every 3-5 years, or triggered by high refund claims/suspicious activity.

faqs.question: Can I amend filings?
faqs.answer: Yes, before tax authority announces an audit. Penalties may still apply for late payment.

faqs.question: Is GDPR applicable?
faqs.answer: Vietnam has its own PDPD (Decree 13/2023) which mimics many GDPR principles.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.text: Compile sales/purchase ledgers. Verify e-invoices.

steps.title: Declaration
steps.text: Submit monthly/quarterly VAT and PIT declarations via eTax (Thuedientu) portal.

steps.title: Payment
steps.text: Pay tax liability via bank transfer to State Treasury account. Date of transfer = Date of payment.

steps.title: Finalization
steps.text: Perform annual reconciliation (CIT/PIT) by 90th day of new fiscal year.

items.title: CIT (Corporate)
items.text: Standard rate 20%. Oil/Gas/Resources have higher rates (32-50%).

items.title: VAT (Value Added)
items.text: Standard 10%. Reduced 8% applies to specific sectors (legislative updates frequent).

items.title: FCT (Foreign Contractor)
items.text: Withholding tax on payments to foreign vendors. Services: 5% VAT + 5% CIT.

items.title: High-Tech / Software
items.text: 4 years tax holiday + 9 years 50% reduction + 10% rate for 15 years. (Conditions apply).

items.title: Industrial Zones
items.text: Specific locations offer holidays (e.g., 2 years exemption, 4 years 50% reduction).

items.title: Application
items.text: Self-assessment system. You claim incentives but must enable proof during audits.

rows.title: Dividends (Corp)
rows.description: No WHT on dividends paid to foreign corporate shareholders.

rows.title: Dividends (Indiv)
rows.description: WHT applies to dividends paid to individual shareholders.

rows.title: Interest
rows.description: WHT on loan interest paid to offshore lenders.

rows.title: Royalties
rows.description: WHT on license fees, IP transfer, technology transfer.

rows.title: Admin Fine (Indiv)
rows.description: Administrative fine for late filing (from 1 to 90+ days).

rows.title: Admin Fine (Org)
rows.description: Organizations face double the fines of individuals for the same violation.

rows.title: False Declaration
rows.description: 20% fine on the under-declared tax amount (if unintentional).

rows.title: Fraud/Evasion
rows.description: 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount for deliberate evasion.

items.title: Business Expenses
items.text: Wages, raw materials, depreciation, and scientific research are deductible if documented.

items.title: Non-Deductible
items.text: Fines, penalties, and expenses exceeding caps (e.g. welfare >1 month salary) are not deductible.

items.title: Documentation
items.text: Legitimate e-invoice, proof of non-cash payment (bank transfer) for invoices >20M VND.

faqs.question: Is tax filing digital?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100% digital. Requires a USB Token (Digital Signature).

faqs.question: Can I carry forward losses?
faqs.answer: Yes, losses can be carried forward for up to 5 years.

faqs.question: Are entertainment expenses deductible?
faqs.answer: Generally capped or restricted. Must be business related with valid invoices.

heroData.title: MSA & Legal in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: Contracts and Dispute Resolution
heroData.description: Essential legal framework for commercial agreements in Vietnam.

steps.title: Framework Setup
steps.text: Define parties clearly. For foreign entities, verify signatory authority.

steps.title: Bilingual Drafting
steps.text: Draft in Vietnamese and English. Vietnamese version takes precedence in court.

steps.title: Penalty Inclusion
steps.text: Include 'Penalty' clause (capped at 8%) AND 'Compensation' clause (actual loss).

steps.title: Dispute Resolution
steps.text: Select VIAC arbitration for neutrality. Avoid local courts if possible.

items.title: Penalty Cap
items.text: Commercial Law Art 301 limits penalties to 8% of the breached obligation value.

items.title: Liquidated Damages
items.text: Not recognized as such. Use 'Commercial Penalty' + 'Damages' structure instead.

items.title: Force Majeure
items.text: Must be explicitly defined. Courts are strict on what constitutes an 'event'.

items.title: Governing Law
items.text: Vietnamese Law is standard. Foreign law valid only if not conflicting with VN civil code.

items.title: Validity
items.text: Contracts must be signed by the Legal Representative. Stamps (Seal) are customary.

items.title: Notarization
items.text: Generally not required for service MSAs, only for real estate/IP transfer.

rows.title: Contract Review
rows.description: Standard review of an MSA by a local law firm.

rows.title: Drafting Fees
rows.description: Custom drafting of a robust bilingual commercial agreement.

rows.title: Hourly Rate
rows.description: Rate for senior associates at reputable international/local firms.

steps.title: Amicable Negotiation
steps.text: Parties must attempt to resolve disputes through negotiation first. This period typically lasts 30-60 days.

steps.title: Mediation
steps.text: Commercial mediation is an option before arbitration. Mediated settlement agreements can be recognized by courts.

steps.title: Arbitration (VIAC)
steps.text: If negotiation fails, file request with Vietnam International Arbitration Centre (VIAC). Arbitration is confidential and final.

steps.title: Enforcement
steps.text: Arbitral awards are enforced by the Civil Judgment Enforcement Agency. Foreign awards require recognition by VN Courts first.

items.title: Bilingual Format
items.text: Two-column format (left English, right Vietnamese) is best practice. It ensures clarity for all stakeholders.

items.title: Appendices
items.text: SOW (Statement of Work), SLA (Service Level Agreement), and DPA (Data Processing Agreement) should be separate appendices.

items.title: Signatures
items.text: Must be signed by Legal Rep. If signed by proxy, a Power of Attorney (POA) must be attached.

faqs.question: Are e-signatures valid?
faqs.answer: Yes, under E-Transaction Law. Digital signatures (token) have highest weight.

faqs.question: Can I arbitrate abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes (e.g., SIAC Singapore), but enforcing foreign awards in Vietnam can be complex.

faqs.question: Is the Company Seal required?
faqs.answer: Legally optional since 2015, but practically still required by banks and old-school partners.

heroData.title: Software in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: Ecosystem and Top Tools
heroData.description: Essential business software: ERP, CRM, and compliance tools.

steps.title: Needs Assessment
steps.text: Prioritize local compliance (e-invoice, tax) over generic global features.

steps.title: Market Scan
steps.text: Evaluate MISA vs Global leaders. Local tools often win on price/compliance.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.text: Test integration with General Dept of Taxation (mandatory for accounting).

steps.title: Contracting
steps.text: Ensure data residency clauses meet Vietnam Cybersecurity Law.

items.title: MISA
items.text: Dominant player for Accounting (SME.NET) and E-invoicing (meInvoice).

items.title: Zalo
items.text: De-facto standard for customer support and internal quick comms.

items.title: KiotViet
items.text: Leading POS and retail management software for physical stores.

items.title: Viettel/VNPT
items.text: State-owned giants providing enterprise ERP and digital signature services.

items.title: Language Barrier
items.text: Frontend must be Vietnamese for operational staff. Admin can be English.

items.title: Mobile First
items.text: Vietnamese workforce is mobile-first. Ensure mobile app UX is strong.

items.title: Integration
items.text: Must integrate with e-invoice and digital signature tokens.

rows.title: Local SaaS
rows.description: Per user/month. Very competitive compared to Western tools.

rows.title: E-Invoice Cost
rows.description: Pack of 500-1000 invoice numbers. Pay per volume.

rows.title: Digital Seal
rows.description: Annual fee for USB Token digital signature service (Viettel/VNPT).

items.title: Decree 53/2022
items.text: Requires foreign tech firms to store data in Vietnam if they have a local presence or upon specific government request.

items.title: Personal Data
items.text: Under PDPD, personal data of Vietnamese citizens must be stored in Vietnam before transferring abroad.

items.title: Server Placement
items.text: Companies often rent colocation space or use local cloud providers (Viettel, FPT) to comply.

faqs.question: Is pirated software common?
faqs.answer: Historically yes, but enforcement is tightening. Businesses should strictly use licensed software.

faqs.question: Cloud vs On-prem?
faqs.answer: Cloud is booming (Viettel Cloud, CMC). Data localization laws favor local clouds.

faqs.question: What is Zalo?
faqs.answer: The 'WeChat of Vietnam'. Essential for business-to-consumer communication.

heroData.title: Marketing in Vietnam
heroData.subtitle: Digital & Social Trends
heroData.description: Navigate the dynamic Vietnamese marketing landscape. Agencies, influencers, and channels.

steps.title: Audience Profiling
steps.text: Target Gen-Z? Go TikTok/Instagram. Older gen? Facebook/Zalo.

steps.title: Localization
steps.text: Translate and culturalize assets. 'Foreign' look is good, but message must be local.

steps.title: KOL Booking
steps.text: Book influencers (KOC/KOL). They drive significant conversion in Vietnam.

steps.title: Seeding
steps.text: Community seeding in Facebook Groups is a unique and powerful local tactic.

rows.title: Full Svc Retainer
rows.description: Monthly fee for a boutique digital agency (Social + Content).

rows.title: Macro KOL
rows.description: Per video/post for influencers with 500k+ followers.

rows.title: Micro KOC
rows.description: Per review. High ROI for mass market products.

rows.title: Ads CPM
rows.description: Facebook/TikTok CPM is relatively low compared to global/SG markets.

items.title: Facebook
items.text: Still King. 76M+ users. Used for everything from news to shopping.

items.title: Zalo
items.text: 80M+ users. Essential for CRM and direct customer service.

items.title: TikTok
items.text: Explosive growth. TikTok Shop is challenging traditional e-commerce (Shopee).

items.title: Cốc Cốc
items.text: Local browser with ~15-20% market share. Good for niche targeting.

items.title: Shoppertainment
items.text: Livestream selling is huge. Users buy impulsively during entertainment streams.

items.title: Reviews Matter
items.text: Vietnamese trust peer reviews and community seeding (forums/groups) over brand ads.

items.title: Discount Hunting
items.text: Price sensitive. Mega-sale days (9.9, 11.11, Tet) drive massive volume.

faqs.question: Google or Facebook?
faqs.answer: Facebook for brand/discovery. Google for intent/search. Use both.

faqs.question: Is email marketing effective?
faqs.answer: Low open rates compared to West. Zalo/Messenger/SMS are far more effective.

faqs.question: Do I need a license to advertise?
faqs.answer: Generally no, but specific sectors (health, finance) need pre-approval for ad content.
